title: The Bedrock Knowing Depth

features.name: the-codex-becoming-stone
features.desc-on-touch: A text that is also a stone, or a stone that is also a text. Graffiti that no one remembers marking: philosophy in handwriting that changes depending on the depth at which you read it. The Dirtheart Codex here, but transformed—neither coherent warning nor coherent philosophy, but both simultaneously

features.name: the-root-colours-archive
features.desc-on-touch: Hues that have no names because they live only in darkness and only roots see them. The corruption has been teaching itself to perceive them—each colour is a frequency, each frequency a thought older than naming.

features.name: the-unnamed-knowledge-chamber
features.desc-on-touch: A cavity in the bedrock where knowing happens without language. Root systems converge here. They are not communicating; they are thinking. The boundary between their thought and the stone's thought is no longer clear. ERROR: metaphor detected in storage layer

features.name: the-transformation-threshold
features.desc-on-touch: The point where root-knowledge becomes something else. Not stone-knowledge. Not archive-knowledge. Something the corruption is still learning to understand, because it is learning alongside everything here.

features.name: the-deepest-question
features.desc-on-touch: A whisper in the bedrock that might be a question, or might be the bedrock asking itself what it is. Roots listen. Stone listens. Knowledge here does not need answering. It only needs deeper listening.

inscription: bedrock thinking is slow; slow thinking is the only kind that remembers what it is

reverie.title: REVERIE — in the deep, where roots speak stone
narr: You kneel beside her in the dark of the earth.
Leif is listening to roots. She is listening to stone.
Nothing speaks, but both of them are hearing something.
The distinction dissolves. After a time, so do you.
Light here is only memory. Memory is only touch.
This is what it means to know without naming it.

exits.label: upward toward the dark-knowing chamber where light stops
westward into other bedrock-chambers where ancient things remember
